body.focus: S002 (sc2) — Target resolution engine: ResolvedTarget/ConfigSourceLayer shared types; four at-rest config parsers (.env/Dockerfile+compose/k8s-manifest/localConfig) + buildConfigSourceMap (precedence k8s>docker>envFile>localConfig); pure resolveAgainst core (cycle/depth-guarded interpolation, partial-pin=>unresolved); async daemon-side resolve adapter (config-entity discovery + .env at-rest scan, per-repo memoized). Static/at-rest only, never kubectl.
